verdict.rationale: Digits ships "Ask Digits", an in-product AI assistant that lets users ask natural-language questions about financials and invoke a documented task mode ("Ask Digits to Get it Done") to complete actions, and additionally exposes an MCP server so natural-language agents in Claude/ChatGPT/Cursor can query live ledger data. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification that Ask Digits' task execution actually works as described, and clarification of how far natural-language commands can go given the MCP server is documented as read-only.
